plan.angle: The live top 10 is a town health PDF, two studio waivers on a waiver tool, a Jotform template and template-library downloads, and every one is a single document filled once. This page lists what a piercing consent form records per piercing (site, jewelry, material, gauge), answers the builder's questions with Florida's statute quoted for minors and record keeping, and shows the form working in a studio: a three-piercing walk-in on one record, a minor's visit with a parent and notarized consent, an allergy answer that flags the record without sending health details, and a downsize visit linked to the original piercing.
tab_stories: At Bluegill Piercing a Saturday walk-in signs on the counter tablet for 3 piercings in one visit, a helix, a forward helix and a nostril, and each piercing is its own line with jewelry, material and gauge on one signed record.

Junebug Piercing in Pensacola asks date of birth first; a 15-year-old client opens a parent section where her mother, Nadia Fenwick, uploads the notarized consent and signs, and the piercer ticks that the parent is in the room before starting.

Talia Brandt answers yes to a metal allergy at Ember Row Piercing; her record is flagged, the piercer gets a Slack message that a form is in with a link to it, and her answer stays in the database until he opens it.
Marlo Keane returns to Bluegill Piercing 6 weeks after a helix piercing for a downsize; the visit is logged under the original piercing with the new bar length, so the record shows both visits.

claims_to_source: In Florida a person may not pierce a minor without the written notarized consent of a parent or legal guardian
In Florida a minor under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian
Florida visit records include the date of visit, the area pierced and the piercer
Florida studios keep each customer visit record for not less than 2 years
Florida studios give each customer written aftercare instructions for the pierced area
Florida's definition of body piercing excludes a mechanized presterilized ear-piercing system on the outer ear or lobe
